## Definition of Ready

- [ ] Acceptance criteria written
- [ ] ADR Status is not "New ADR Required" (resolved, or explicitly accepted as non-blocking)
- [ ] Blocking dependencies identified and resolved or explicitly accepted
- [ ] No open question requiring an architect/lead decision

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All scope items complete with real evidence (not assumed passing)
- [ ] Tests pass for real
- [ ] Documentation updated in the same change
- [ ] No new SEC-010 violations
- [ ] ADR compliance confirmed
- [ ] Runbook updated if operationally significant
